title: Striped Fingerless Gloves
description: Fun, modern fingerless gloves knitted in the round with bold stripes and a tidy thumb gusset. Worked in DK weight yarn, these knit up quickly and are endlessly customisable with your own colour combinations. A brilliant intermediate project that makes an excellent gift.
yarnRequirements: 50g each of 2–3 colours DK weight yarn (approx. 110m per colour). Shown in navy and cream.
gauge: 24 sts × 32 rows = 10 cm in stocking stitch on 3.75 mm needles
materials: 3.75 mm DPNs or small circular needles

instructions.title: Cuff
instructions.body: Cast on 44 sts in Colour A onto 3.25 mm needles. Join to work in the round. Work k2, p2 rib for 4 cm.

instructions.title: Stripe Body
instructions.body: Switch to 3.75 mm needles. Work stripes as follows: 4 rounds Colour A, 4 rounds Colour B. Carry yarns loosely up the inside. Continue stripe pattern until glove measures 10 cm from cast-on.

instructions.title: Thumb Gusset
instructions.body: Round 1: k1, pm, m1L, k1, m1R, pm, k to end. Round 2–3: knit. Round 4: k1, sm, m1L, k to marker, m1R, sm, k to end. Repeat rounds 2–4 until you have 13 gusset sts between markers. Next round: k1, transfer 13 gusset sts to waste yarn, cast on 1 st, k to end (44 sts).

instructions.title: Hand
instructions.body: Continue stripe pattern until glove measures 20 cm total. Work 2 cm k2, p2 rib. Cast off loosely in rib.

instructions.title: Thumb
instructions.body: Transfer held gusset sts to needles, pick up 3 sts from the hand gap (16 sts). Work in the round in stocking stitch for 2.5 cm. Cast off loosely.

reviews.author: tomwilliams88
reviews.body: These are my go-to gift pattern now. Fast, fun and the stripes look amazing. Made 4 pairs already and everyone loves them.

reviews.author: _knitbyme_
reviews.body: Really enjoyed making these! The thumb gusset instrutions could be a bit clearer but once you get it its totally fine. Beautiful result and so warm.

reviews.author: Lucy_M
reviews.body: Made a pair in a weekend! Love how customisable the stripe colours are. Wore them all winter.

reviews.author: craftdad
reviews.body: Made a pair for my wife but the sizing came up quite large for her - more of a medium/large than I expected from a 'one size'. Pattern itself is fine, just wish there were more size options.

reviews.author: BethKnits
reviews.body: My 4th pair of fingerless gloves and by far the best pattern i've used. The thumb gusset sits really comfortably.

reviews.author: rosie.j
reviews.body: Great quick project. I substituted a different DK yarn and it worked out brilliantly. The stripes are very forgiving for colour changes.
